description: This file defines memory management functions and macros for the USP Agent, including wrappers around malloc, free, realloc, and strdup, as well as initialization, destruction, and leak reporting functionalities.

methods.name: USP_MEM_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys and cleans up the memory management system.

methods.name: USP_MEM_Malloc
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of specified size, with debug info.

methods.name: USP_MEM_Free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block, with debug info.

methods.name: USP_MEM_Realloc
methods.description: Reallocates a memory block to a new size, with debug info.

methods.name: USP_MEM_Strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string or block of memory, with debug info.

methods.name: USP_MEM_StartCollection
methods.description: Starts collecting memory allocations for leak detection.

methods.name: USP_MEM_PrintSummary
methods.description: Prints a summary of memory usage.

methods.name: USP_MEM_PrintLeakReport
methods.description: Reports memory leaks found during collection.

methods.name: USP_MEM_PrintAll
methods.description: Prints details of all memory allocations and deallocations.

methods.name: MAIN_Stop
methods.description: Stops the main process, possibly related to memory or system shutdown.
